tiers.noi_bo: Insider tips: anonymous ones are often traps, colleagues are moderately reliable

schema_note: direction = direction of change of the quantity named in the headline. state_direction = direction of the matching hidden state variable (lai_suat up = loans cost more; ty_gia up = pressure on importers, i.e. the lac weakens; nguyen_lieu up = costlier inputs; suc_mua up = better demand; chung_khoan up = index rises; tin_dung up = easier borrowing, down = harder). link = state:<variable> or event:<event id> or null. exaggerates = the item overstates, so it can be a trap even when the direction is right.

kinds.signal: reflects the true state or a real shock
kinds.trap: false or exaggerated, easy to misread
kinds.partial: partly true, magnitude missing or wrong
